title: Monthly PAPI Inspection

footer.manualLine: Visual Aid and Electrical System Maintenance Manual.

items.text: LOTO applied and de-energization verified before any contact with fixtures
All four PAPI housing units inspected — no damage, moisture, or contamination
All PAPI lenses cleaned with approved optical cleaning agent
Failed lamps replaced with EXACT OEM-specified lamp type and wattage
Circuit restored; all four PAPI units fully illuminated
Correct PAPI signal (red-white transition) verified from runway extended centerline at approach direction
No misalignment anomaly observed during signal verification
ATC notified of PAPI status (any change must be immediately reported)

validationRules: Every item marked NOSAT requires non-empty remarks before submission.
notes: Item codes C05-01.. are SYNTHETIC. The approved form lists items without identifiers; codes exist only so responses, incidents and audit records can reference a row, and must never be printed on the exported form.
Generated by scripts/vaes-extract.mjs from the approved base PDF. Re-run it rather than hand-editing; every coordinate is a measured glyph position.
Document control values are pre-printed constants on the approved form — not inputs, and never overlaid.
